verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official materials claim "thousands of applications" backed by the full Ubuntu archive for packages and updates. The desktop docs include guides to install and remove applications and add software repositories, and the site names mainstream apps such as Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam and OBS Studio. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming and describing the official graphical catalog (e.g. the store app and its browsing/search experience), independent or hands-on corroboration of the catalog's size and install flow.
